about: F10's capture of the kit board (the same specimen state as pkg/F7/states.json "kit-board"): /playground in the board layout, 1300 x 5094 at scale 1, so the data lane's four cells of column 3 (statBlock, segBar week, segBar count, macroCol) can be laid over _components-2.png by docs/pipeline/pulse/pkg/_int/kit-board-tiles.mjs.
